<!-- Generated by tools/cli-reference.py from `backdown volumes --help`. Edit the help in crates/backdown-cli (or the notes in the script) and run it again. -->


```text
backdown volumes [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

`--json`
: Print it as JSON, for scripts.

Also takes the [global options](/docs/cli/#global-options) `--db` and `--local`.

## Good to know

Reads sysfs, udev and mountinfo on Linux, `diskutil` on macOS and the storage cmdlets on Windows. It never mounts or writes anything, says what BackDown can do with each partition (mountable, mounted, system, encrypted, part of a volume group, swap, empty), and marks the volumes an existing index covers.

## Examples

```sh
backdown volumes
backdown volumes --json
```
